sources.fact: Regulation 19 HTML lists CI - Thames Road as a site-allocation attachment.
The Regulation 19 decision is Local Plan provenance and not a CI parcel permission.
LBBD states the Thames Road Vision and Design Code SPD was adopted on 14 May 2025.
The adopted SPD provides a broad spatial vision for 3,500 homes across the Thames Road area.
The SPD is a policy framework and material consideration, not one planning permission for 3,500 homes.
The Assembly adopted the Thames Road SPD after consultation; adoption remains policy guidance.
The July 2023 Committee considered a distinct mixed-use residential application at 13-15A Thames Road, 22/02211/FULL.
The 13-15A resolution included a legal-agreement deadline and delegated refusal/extension options, so Committee support is not treated as whole-CI finality.
The December 2020 Committee considered a separate proposal at 12 Thames Road for up to 156 residential units plus industrial and cafe floorspace.
The 2020 purchase decision for 25 Thames Road concerned acquisition and asset strategy, not residential permission.
Historic use-class permission at 45 Thames Road is kept separate from current transformation-area housing evidence.
No exact single CI parcel boundary, current complete application set or HMLR title topology for the 3,500-home area vision was verified this wave.

examples.result: CI allocation identity is retained from Regulation 19 HTML.
The 3,500-home figure is an area-wide SPD vision, not one parcel consent.
13-15A Thames Road is a distinct application and is not treated as the whole CI allocation.
The 12 Thames Road 156-unit proposal is not added mechanically to the 3,500-home vision.
Committee resolutions with legal-agreement deadlines are not issued-final permission proof.
The 25 Thames Road acquisition is asset governance, not housing consent or full-area title.
Historic employment/place-of-worship cases are not transferred into current residential capacity.
Promotion remains zero until exact current cases, parcel/title relations and overlays are verified.
